summary: DR-ROI-001 Phase A+B frontend-only verification. Verified V2 disabled preview, opt-in flow, feature flag helper, V1 route untouched, and route reachability. All acceptance criteria pass with 0 console errors.

test_results.v2_disabled_state: PASS - data-testid='dr-v2-disabled' renders; back link data-testid='dr-v2-back-to-v1' href=/new-daily-report; shell absent.
test_results.v2_opt_in_shell: PASS - dr-v2-shell, dr-v2-sections, dr-v2-panels present. 14 dr-v2-section-* testids found (10 required sections: day-setup, crew-time, equipment, activity-cards, constraint-chips, tomorrow, safety-quality, photos, ai-summary, signature + 4 panel section cards: panel-confidence, panel-pm, panel-photo-intel, panel-approval). All 4 intelligence panels render without JS errors.
test_results.feature_flag_api: PASS - localStorage.getItem('dr_v2_optin') returned None initially; after setItem('1') returned '1'; behavior matches isDailyReportV2Enabled() gating (disabled -> preview, enabled -> shell).
test_results.v1_untouched: PASS - /daily/new renders V1 with h1 'Daily Job Report'; no 'dr-v2-' selectors present in DOM; SUBMIT button visible.
test_results.route_mount_smoke: PASS - /daily-report/v2 reachable (no 404, no white screen) in both flag states.
test_results.console_errors: PASS - 0 console errors across all three route/state combinations.

critical_code_review_comments: SectionCard renders dr-v2-section-panel-* testids for each intelligence panel too. Not a bug but consumers filtering '[data-testid^=dr-v2-section-]' will see 14 not 10. Consider naming the panel cards with a distinct prefix (e.g. dr-v2-panel-card-*) to keep 'section' semantics clean.
dailyReportV2Flag.js only reads env at module load — process.env.REACT_APP_DR_V2_ENABLED is baked at build time (CRA), which is expected. Comment could clarify this to avoid future confusion.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase A+B shell complete and verified. Next phases (C: AI wiring, G: submit cutover) are not implemented yet — do NOT test AI or POST paths against /daily-report/v2. V1 route at /daily/new (renders 'Daily Job Report') is legally-critical and must remain untouched.
